title: Supported polynomial localization as an affine base module stalk
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], $U\subseteq Y$ an open, $V\subseteq X$ an affine open contained in $f^{-1}U$, and $n\in\mathbb N$. Write $A=\Gamma(Y,U)$, $B=\Gamma(X,V)$, $R=A[t_1,\ldots,t_n]$. Let $g:R\to B$ be surjective and restrict on $A$ to the section map of $f$. For a prime $p$ of $R$ with $\ker g\subseteq p$, there exist $x\in V$ and an isomorphism of $A$-modules from the localization of the $R$-module $B$ at $p$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization], restricted through $A\to R\to R_p$, to $\mathcal O_{X,x}$ with action through the germ $A\to\mathcal O_{Y,f(x)}$ followed by the actual stalk homomorphism of $f$. There are no Tor, finite type, or Noetherian assumptions.

proof.text: Form q = p.map g. Ideal.map_isPrime_of_surjective gives primality; Ideal.comap_map_of_surjective and the kernel inclusion give g inverse image of q equal to p. Set x to the inverse image of q under hV.isoSpec. Its associated prime is q by the iso inverse identity. The lemma Ideal.map_primeCompl_comap_of_surjective identifies the image under g of the prime complement of p with the prime complement of q.

proof.text: The affine germ B to the source stalk is localization at q by IsAffineOpen.isLocalization_stalk. Give B its R-algebra structure via g and the stalk the composite algebra structure. The equality of prime complements and isLocalizedModule_iff_isLocalization show that the R-linear germ is a module localization at p. Compare it with ModuleCat.localizedModuleMkLinearMap using IsLocalizedModule.linearEquiv.

proof.text: Restrict this R-linear equivalence to the displayed A action. IsScalarTower.algebraMap_smul compares localization-ring and R scalar multiplication. Germ naturality and the compatibility g.comp C = f.appLE show that the resulting action equals the base germ followed by f.stalkMap, giving precisely the stated module isomorphism.

lean.statement:
theorem affinePolynomial_supportedLocalization_stalk
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    (U : Y.Opens) (V : X.Opens) (hV : IsAffineOpen V) (e : V ≤ f ⁻¹ᵁ U)
    (n : ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(Y, U) →+* Γ(X, V))
    (hg : Function.Surjective g)
    (hcomp : g.comp MvPolynomial.C = (f.appLE U V e).hom)
    (p : PrimeSpectrum (MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(Y, U)))
    (hker : RingHom.ker g ≤ p.asIdeal) :
    ∃ (x : X) (hx : x ∈ V), Nonempty
      (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
          ((algebraMap (MvPolynomial (Fin n) Γ(Y, U))
            (Localization p.asIdeal.primeCompl)).comp MvPolynomial.C)).obj
          (((ModuleCat.restrictScalars g).obj
            (ModuleCat.of Γ(X, V) Γ(X, V))).localizedModule p.asIdeal.primeCompl)) ≅
        (ModuleCat.restrictScalars ((f.stalkMap x).hom.comp
          (Y.presheaf.germ U (f x) (e hx)).hom)).obj
            (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk x) (X.presheaf.stalk x)))
